current_evidence: The apply-planning-permission page links two sub-pages, 'Additional Plans required in Erewash' and 'Additional Reports required in Erewash' (node/354), which hold the local requirements. No dated local list PDF was found (the 2025 'local list' FAQ PDF is about the List of Buildings of Local Interest, not validation).

issues.detail: Grokbot read only the general 'apply for planning permission' page and took its items from the 'Specific National Validation Requirements' section (archaeology, SuDS, FRA, Town Centre Impact, Viability, DAS for LBC), which cites national policy drivers. It never opened the two linked local requirement pages.
issues.evidence: Page: local lists are on 'Additional Plans required in Erewash' and 'Additional Reports required in Erewash'; 'Specific National Validation Requirements' attributed to national policy

issues.detail: Missed local reports from node/354: Bat Survey Report (all applications involving demolition, barn conversions, and conversions involving roof-space works next to relevant landscape features); Protected Species Survey Report (greenfield, re-vegetated brownfield, or sites next to a watercourse involving change of use of land or new buildings, excluding householder); Noise Impact Assessment (noisy development near sensitive uses, sensitive uses near noise sources, mixed use, commercial extraction/cooling units); Local Planning Statement details (major housing of 10 or more dwellings; Core Strategy Policies 8 and 19, saved H7/H9); Wind Turbine applications (LVIA, planning statement, wildlife surveys for all turbines except single-dwelling domestic use).

Missed local plan requirements: existing/proposed elevations and floor plans (new buildings, extensions, change of use); site sections and finished floor/site levels (sloping sites or a change in ground level); roof plan (unless flat or mono-pitched); existing site plan (all applications); proposed block plan (fewer than 10 buildings); proposed master plan (10 or more buildings).

All Grokbot items except DAS are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' and are national rather than local requirements. Householder is not populated even though the local plan requirements (elevations, floor plans, roof plan, site plan) apply to extensions, and Protected Species explicitly excludes householder applications.
The Archaeology and FRA trigger excerpts are guidance sentences on what the assessment should contain, not when it is required.
issues.evidence: 'an appropriate desk-based assessment should be employed and, where necessary, a field evaluation.'

issues.detail: Neither the Erewash local requirements nor their pages are dated, and they cite outdated drivers (Circular 06/05, Habitats Regs 2010, 2013 PPG), so the list looks old and unreviewed. The workbook should say it is undated.
issues.evidence: node/354 policy drivers list 'Habitats Regulations 2010; Circular 06/05'

summary: Grokbot's link is a general page, and it captured national requirements instead of Erewash's actual local requirements, which sit on two linked sub-pages (Additional Plans, Additional Reports). All 5 local reports and 7 local plan requirements are missing.
